summary: Iteration 5 CMS full-stack verified. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests passed (auth login/me/unauthorized, news full CRUD, projects list/get/seed=11, services-overrides upsert/get/delete, file upload+serve, all 3 PDF catalogs and 2 showreel mp4s return 200). Frontend: admin login, dashboard with 3 tabs (News/Projects/Services), 7 service-tab division testids present, 11 project-rows including rumah-gadang-chalet-jempol, news creation via UI works (row appears in news-list), news-section + news-grid + news-modal visible on home, WhatsApp FAB correctly hidden on /admin, logout redirects to /admin/login, protected /admin redirects unauthenticated users, project detail page loads bilingual data from /api/projects, Production division accordion exposes division-production-video-0/-1 and division-production-catalog-0/-1/-2 with correct /armeen/catalogs/{camera,lens,audio}-catalog.pdf hrefs. No console errors on any page.
action_items: (Minor / testability) BiInput component (used in NewsManager + ServicesManager + ProjectsManager) renders bilingual EN/BM input pairs but does not propagate per-field data-testid attributes. Reference request expected testids like news-title-en/bm, service-summary-en, etc. Recommend adding optional testIdPrefix prop to BiInput so each input gets `${testIdPrefix}-en` / `${testIdPrefix}-bm` for robust UI automation. Functionally everything works; this is purely test ergonomics.

(Optional) Add `data-testid` on Save changes / Reset to default buttons inside ServicesManager (currently only matchable by text) and on news editor Save (already has news-save) — same pattern across managers for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS uses allow_origin_regex='.*' WITH allow_credentials=True — this works only because frontend axios is set to withCredentials=false (Bearer-token flow). Acceptable for current setup; just be aware browser will reject any future credentialed call.
server.py is ~630 lines (DEFAULT_PROJECTS seed dominates). Acceptable, but if it grows further consider moving seed data to a separate JSON or seeds module.
MongoDB _id is properly excluded in all find queries (good).
JWT secret, admin credentials read from env (no hardcoded values).
Auth dependency get_current_user supports both cookie and Bearer (matches frontend strategy).
Seed admin updates password if the env password changed — good for environment rotations.
Upload endpoint validates extension whitelist and uses uuid filenames — good.
No rate-limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login — playbook mentions 5-fail lockout; not implemented. Not blocking but worth noting.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (every required assertion verified either by UI or by the corresponding backend integration)

seed_data_creation: Test news items created during UI runs were cleaned up at the end (news collection left empty). No projects or service-overrides were left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_cms_backend.py covers full CMS API surface and asset HEAD checks; rerun with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_cms_backend.py -v. UI testids of note: data-testid on login-email/password/submit, admin-dashboard, tab-news/projects/services, news-new/save, news-list, news-row-<id>, news-edit-<id>, news-delete-<id>, news-editor, project-row-<slug>, project-editor, service-tab-<key> (7 keys: construction, electrical-mechanical, it, production, corporate-gift, ev-charger, laundry), services-editor, news-section, news-grid, news-card-<id>, news-modal, division-production-video-0/1, division-production-catalog-0/1/2, logout-button. Note: bilingual BiInput sub-inputs do NOT have testids — match them via placeholder text like 'Title (EN)' / 'Short summary (EN)' / 'Full body (BM)'.
rca of the issue: No issues detected — all features in the review request are implemented and working end-to-end.
